title: LAN AMOEBA — sporeGate wraps the home network
insight: sporeGate was never a 'gate' or 'foreman.' It was always the LAN AMOEBA — the Schwann cell that myelinates the home network. It already runs dnsmasq (knows every device), swarmVine (finds peers), songBird (orchestrates mesh), bearDog (signs trust). It IS the home immune system.

wan.role: ISP uplink — just a pipe. Not Gaia's identity.

router.role: Routes packets. DHCP. Firewall. Normal router.

mikrotik.role: L2 bridge — extends the physical LAN

sporeGate.was: Build foreman, SSH authority, depot orchestrator
sporeGate.is_now: LAN AMOEBA — the Schwann cell wrapping the home network

services.dnsmasq: DNS for entire LAN — it knows every device by name
services.swarmVine: gossip discovery — 6 peers, finds new devices
services.songBird: mesh orchestration — routes traffic, coordinates gates
services.bearDog: crypto signing — LAN trust authority, Ed25519

sporeGate.needs: AMOEBA (RustDesk) client installed for visual access
sporeGate.path_in: Pi → WireGuard (192.168.4.3) → sporeGate → install RustDesk → eyes open

layer_2_devices.others: phones, tablets, TVs, printers — normal home devices

layer_3_amoeba.role: sporeGate wraps ALL of layer 1 and layer 2
